description:
instantiate_open_inputs (src/compiler2/jobs/semantic.rs) asks column_is_open: a callable column stays on plain has_vars, every other column reads has_open_vars.

Fails before, passes after: instantiate_open_inputs_keeps_a_list_of_closures (left Ty(7) is [], right Ty(17)); instantiate_open_inputs_refines_a_callable_column_by_the_contract_arrow guards the callable column; fixture 01080 (base prints 1 1 2 2, Elixir 2 3 2 2) on three paths. Fixture 01082: at base it stops with the boxed-lane error; with the first site alone it compiles but Enum.map over a list of closures loses elements ([3] where Elixir prints [3, 4], [3, 3, 3] and [3, 3]); it passes here.

Acceptance: full gate green; no pin changes.
title: A list of closures is not an open column
